flagged.location: Statement, second paragraph (density-matrix definition and trace pairing)
flagged.evidence: The Statement uses “Tr ρ=1” and “Tr(ρA)” without defining the finite-dimensional trace. Proof 3.1 later uses Tr(AB)=ΣᵢⱼAᵢⱼBⱼᵢ but never states Tr(A)=ΣᵢAᵢᵢ. The declared dependencies do not include def-trace-of-an-endomorphism, whose published definition supplies the basis-independent trace convention.

After defining f(M) spectrally, the Statement says “logarithms on positive supports are well defined,” but does not define the positive-support subspace or specify the logarithm convention when M has zero eigenvalues. No declared dependency supplies support for an arbitrary Hermitian M; def-qc-density-operator defines support only for density operators and is not a dependency.

The Statement claims rank-one densities are exactly “the extreme points of the finite density-matrix set.” Proof 5.1 uses the strict-convex-combination criterion without defining “extreme point,” and the declared dependencies do not include def-extreme-point-and-face, whose published definition gives that criterion.
